cases.label: 읽기·변환·저장의 순서와 최종 값
cases.probe: const events=[]; const result=await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>{events.push('read');cb(null,4);}, value=>{events.push('transform:'+value);return Promise.resolve(value*3);}, value=>{events.push('save:'+value);return {stored:value};}); observe({events,result});

cases.label: 콜백의 비동기 완료를 기다린다
cases.probe: const events=[]; const result=await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>{events.push('registered');Promise.resolve().then(()=>{events.push('callback');cb(undefined,0);});}, value=>{events.push('transform');return value+1;}, value=>{events.push('save');return value;}); observe({events,result});

cases.label: read의 throw와 콜백 오류를 원인 그대로 전파
cases.probe: const outcomes=[]; for(const reason of [new Error('read'),0,false,'']){let transforms=0;let saves=0;try{await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>cb(reason,9),()=>{transforms++;},()=>{saves++;});outcomes.push({rejected:false});}catch(error){outcomes.push({same:error===reason,transforms,saves});}} const thrown=new Error('sync');try{await submission.runCallbackPipeline(()=>{throw thrown;},()=>1,()=>2);outcomes.push({rejected:false});}catch(error){outcomes.push({same:error===thrown});} observe(outcomes);

cases.label: 변환의 throw/rejection 뒤에는 저장하지 않는다
cases.probe: const outcomes=[];for(const asynchronous of [false,true]){const reason=new Error('transform');let saves=0;try{await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>cb(null,5),()=>{if(asynchronous)return Promise.reject(reason);throw reason;},()=>{saves++;});outcomes.push({rejected:false});}catch(error){outcomes.push({same:error===reason,saves});}}observe(outcomes);

cases.label: 저장의 실패를 성공으로 숨기지 않는다
cases.probe: const outcomes=[];for(const asynchronous of [false,true]){const reason={code:'WRITE'};try{await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>cb(null,2),value=>value*2,()=>{if(asynchronous)return Promise.reject(reason);throw reason;});outcomes.push(false);}catch(error){outcomes.push(error===reason);}}observe(outcomes);

cases.label: 중복 콜백과 뒤늦은 throw는 최초 완료를 덮지 않는다
cases.probe: let transforms=0;let saves=0;const result=await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>{cb(null,2);cb(new Error('late'));cb(null,99);throw new Error('after');},value=>{transforms++;return value+1;},value=>{saves++;return value*2;});const reason=new Error('first');let same=false;try{await submission.runCallbackPipeline(cb=>{cb(reason);cb(null,8);},value=>value,value=>value);}catch(error){same=error===reason;}observe({result,transforms,saves,firstRejection:same});
